_meta.source: SEO plan section 6 (Keyword to URL map). Build-only file: never import it into src/.
_meta.rule: Every brief keyword appears exactly once (case-insensitive) across pages[*].primary, pages[*].secondary, pages[*].supporting, gbpOnly[].keyword and notTargeted[].keyword. Page keywords that are not in the brief are plan additions to validate in Keyword Planner before finalising headings.

roles.supporting: section or FAQ text; also holds the unmodified broad terms (M_broad_validate) the page covers through its Winnipeg primary
roles.gbpOnly: 'near me' terms won by the Google Business Profile; fallback is the page the GBP and audits point to
roles.notTargeted: deliberately not targeted, with the reason

status.live: URL is a prerendered route today
status.planned: URL does not exist yet; ships per plan sections 5 and 9
status.blocked: URL can never truthfully exist as planned (`reason` says why); its keywords live on other pages (`keywordsMovedTo`), so the entry holds none and the audit skips it

optionalFields.ownerConfirms: keywords marked * in plan section 6: use only once the owner confirms that work. A flag on keywords already assigned on the same page, not a second assignment
optionalFields.currentUrl: where the content lives today, before the planned URL replaces it
optionalFields.interimFallback: gbpOnly: page to use while the planned fallback page is not live
optionalFields.reason: blocked pages: why the URL cannot exist
optionalFields.keywordsMovedTo: blocked pages: where each of its former keywords is now assigned
